name: Immedia Semiconductor
old_description: Our smart security cameras let you see, hear, and speak from the Blink Home Monitor app. Experience HD day and night video, two way audio, motion detection, and more. Get up to two years of battery life* with our wire-free devices.
about:
Immedia Semiconductor, headquartered in Andover, Massachusetts, operates as a wholly owned subsidiary of Amazon under the Blink brand. The company focuses on designing and marketing wire-free smart security cameras and related devices for residential and small-business use.

The product line includes the Outdoor 2K+ camera, which delivers 2K resolution and enhanced audio in a wire-free design; the compact plug-in Mini 2K+ camera with expansive coverage; the Blink Arc mount that pairs two Mini 2K+ units for a 180-degree panoramic view; and a second-generation battery-powered video doorbell with an expanded field of view. All devices connect to the Blink Home Monitor app for live viewing, two-way audio, and motion alerts, and they integrate with Alexa-enabled devices for voice control. The cameras are marketed as wire-free with up to two years of battery life under typical usage.

Blink devices are sold directly to consumers and small businesses for home security, vacation property monitoring, and small-office surveillance. The system supports multi-system management in a single app, allowing users to oversee multiple locations simultaneously.

The company emphasizes affordability, ease of installation, and integration with Amazon's Alexa ecosystem as key differentiators.
